blocks.content: In the previous lessons, we explored asynchronous JavaScript. And, we have been using the .then() and .catch() to work with asynchronous operations.
Although promise chaining is effective, there is a cleaner and more readable alternative to handle asynchronous operations in JavaScript: async and await.
The async and await keywords make working with Promises easier. They let you write asynchronous code that looks like synchronous code.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
